webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /usr/local/bin/healthcheck.sh
#!/bin/bash
# healthcheck.sh - restart nginx if health check fails
ENDPOINT="http://127.0.0.1/health"
MAX_RETRIES=3

if [ "$1" = "--restart-nginx" ]; then
    for i in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do
        STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$ENDPOINT" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$STATUS" != "200" ]; then
            echo "$(date) - Health check failed (attempt $i/$MAX_RETRIES), restarting nginx" >> /var/log/healthcheck.log
            systemctl restart nginx
            sleep 5
        else
            exit 0
        fi
    done
    echo "$(date) - All health check attempts failed" >> /var/log/healthcheck.log
    exit 1
fi
